verses.original: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל־ נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·w·’āḇ kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hō·w ’el- nə·ḇōw kî šud·dā·ḏāh hō·ḇî·šāh nil·kə·ḏāh qir·yā·ṯā·yim hō·ḇî·šāh ham·miś·gāḇ wā·ḥāt·tāh
verses.literal: Concerning Moab this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Woe to Nebo for it will be devastated Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced the fortress will be shattered and dismantled
verses.literalPt: CONTRA Moabe, assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Ai de Nebo, porque foi destruída; envergonhada está Quiriataim, já está tomada; Misgabe está envergonhada e desanimada.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־ מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên ‘ō·wḏ tə·hil·laṯ mō·w·’āḇ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ḥā·šə·ḇū ‘ā·le·hā rā·‘āh lə·ḵū wə·naḵ·rî·ṯen·nāh mig·gō·w gam- maḏ·mên tid·dōm·mî ’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ tê·leḵ ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: There is no longer praise for Moab in Heshbon they devise evil against her Come let us cut her off from nationhood You too O people of Madmen will be silenced the sword will pursue you
verses.literalPt: A glória de Moabe já não existe mais; em Hesbom tramaram mal contra ela, dizendo: Vinde, e exterminemo-la, para que não seja mais nação; também tu, ó Madmém, serás silenciada; a espada te perseguirá.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ṣə·‘ā·qāh mê·ḥō·rō·w·nā·yim šōḏ wā·še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: A voice cries out from Horonaim Devastation and great destruction
verses.literalPt: Voz de clamor de Horonaim; ruína e grande destruição!

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה צְעוֹרֶיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: niš·bə·rāh mō·w·’āḇ hiš·mî·‘ū zə·‘ā·qāh ṣə·ʿō·rɛ·hå̄
verses.literal: Moab . . . will be shattered her little ones will cry out
verses.literalPt: Está destruída Moabe; seus filhinhos fizeram ouvir um clamor.

verses.original: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלֻּחוֹת בִּבְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־ בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת־ שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ma·‘ă·lêh hal·lu·ḥōṯ biḇ·ḵî ya·‘ă·leh- be·ḵî kî bə·mō·w·raḏ ḥō·w·rō·na·yim ṣā·rê ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ- še·ḇer šā·mê·‘ū
verses.literal: For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound over the destruction
verses.literalPt: Porque pela subida de Luíte eles irão com choro contínuo; porque na descida de Horonaim os adversários de Moabe ouviram as angústias do grito da destruição.

verses.original: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: nu·sū mal·lə·ṭū nap̄·šə·ḵem wə·ṯih·ye·nāh ka·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Flee Run for your lives Become like a juniper in the desert
verses.literalPt: Fugi, salvai a vossa vida; sede como a tamargueira no deserto;

verses.original: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֙יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ גַּם־ אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְיָצָ֤א כְמִישׁ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו יַחַד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ya·‘an biṭ·ḥêḵ bə·ma·‘ă·śa·yiḵ ū·ḇə·’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯa·yiḵ gam- ’at til·lā·ḵê·ḏî wə·yā·ṣā ḵə·mīš bag·gō·w·lāh kō·hă·nāw wə·śā·rāw ya·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: Because you trust in your works and treasures you too will be captured and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials
verses.literalPt: Porque, por causa da tua confiança nas tuas obras, e nos teus tesouros, também tu serás tomada; e Quemós sairá para o cativeiro, os seus sacerdotes e os seus príncipes juntamente.

verses.original: וְיָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל־ כָּל־ עִ֗יר וְעִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְאָבַ֥ד הָעֵ֖מֶק וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḇō šō·ḏêḏ ’el- kāl- ‘îr wə·‘îr lō ṯim·mā·lêṭ wə·’ā·ḇaḏ hā·‘ê·meq wə·niš·maḏ ham·mî·šōr ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: The destroyer will move against every city and not one town will escape The valley will also be ruined and the high plain will be destroyed as the LORD has said
verses.literalPt: Porque virá o destruidor sobre cada uma das cidades, e nenhuma cidade escapará, e perecerá o vale, e destruir-se-á a campina; porque o SENHOR o disse.

verses.original: תְּנוּ־ צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nū- ṣîṣ lə·mō·w·’āḇ kî nā·ṣō tê·ṣê wə·‘ā·re·hā lə·šam·māh ṯih·ye·nāh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ bā·hên
verses.literal: Put salt on Moab for she will be laid waste . . . her cities will become desolate with no one to dwell in them
verses.literalPt: Dai asas a Moabe; porque voando sairá, e as suas cidades se tornarão em desolação, e ninguém morará nelas.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ‘ō·śeh mə·le·ḵeṯ Yah·weh rə·mî·yāh wə·’ā·rūr mō·nê·a‘ ḥar·bōw mid·dām
verses.literal: Cursed is the one who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que fizer a obra do SENHOR fraudulosamente; e maldito aquele que retém a sua espada do sangue.

verses.original: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־ שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־ הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־ כֶּ֔לִי וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ša·’ă·nan mō·w·’āḇ min·nə·‘ū·rāw wə·šō·qêṭ hū ’el- šə·mā·rāw wə·lō- hū·raq mik·kə·lî ’el- ke·lî ū·ḇag·gō·w·lāh lō hā·lāḵ ‘al- kên ‘ā·maḏ ṭa‘·mōw bōw wə·rê·ḥōw lō nā·mār
verses.literal: Moab has been at ease from youth settled . . . like wine on its dregs he has not been poured from vessel to vessel or gone into exile So . . . his flavor has remained the same and his aroma is unchanged
verses.literalPt: Moabe esteve descansado desde a sua mocidade, e repousou nas suas fezes, e não foi mudado de vasilha para vasilha, nem foi para o cativeiro; por isso conservou o seu sabor, e o seu cheiro não se alterou.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּ֖ה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ ל֥וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְצֵעֻ֑הוּ וְכֵלָ֣יו יָרִ֔יקוּ וְנִבְלֵיהֶ֖ם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·šil·laḥ·tî- lōw ṣō·‘îm wə·ṣê·‘u·hū wə·ḵê·lāw yā·rî·qū wə·niḇ·lê·hem yə·nap·pê·ṣū
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will send to him wanderers who will pour him out They will empty his vessels and shatter his jars
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que dias vêm, diz o SENHOR, em que lhe enviarei derramadores que o derramarão; e despejarão as suas vasilhas, e romperão os seus odres.

verses.original: וּבֹ֥שׁ מוֹאָ֖ב מִכְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בֹּ֙שׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ית אֵ֖ל מִבְטֶחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇōš mō·w·’āḇ mik·kə·mō·wōš ka·’ă·šer- bō·šū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mib·bêṯ ’êl miḇ·ṭe·ḥām
verses.literal: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh just as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel
verses.literalPt: E Moabe terá vergonha de Quemós como a casa de Israel se envergonhou de Betel, sua confiança.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ tō·mə·rū gib·bō·w·rîm ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū wə·’an·šê- ḥa·yil lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: How can you say We are warriors mighty men ready for battle
verses.literalPt: Como direis: Somos valentes e homens fortes para a guerra?

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ וְעָרֶ֣יהָ עָלָ֔ה וּמִבְחַ֥ר בַּֽחוּרָ֖יו יָרְד֣וּ לַטָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šud·daḏ mō·w·’āḇ wə·‘ā·re·hā ‘ā·lāh ū·miḇ·ḥar ba·ḥū·rāw yā·rə·ḏū laṭ·ṭā·ḇaḥ nə·’um- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: Moab has been destroyed and its towns have been invaded the best of its young men have gone down in the slaughter declares the King whose name is the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Moabe está destruído, e subiu das suas cidades, e os seus jovens escolhidos desceram à matança, diz o Rei, cujo nome é o SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: קָר֥וֹב אֵיד־ מוֹאָ֖ב לָב֑וֹא וְרָ֣עָת֔וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rō·wḇ ’êḏ- mō·w·’āḇ lā·ḇō·w wə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw mi·hă·rāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Moab’s calamity is at hand . . . and his affliction is rushing swiftly
verses.literalPt: Está prestes a vir a calamidade de Moabe; e apressa-se muito a sua aflição.

verses.original: נֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ כָּל־ סְבִיבָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה נִשְׁבַּר֙ מַטֵּה־ עֹ֔ז מַקֵּ֖ל תִּפְאָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nu·ḏū lōw kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇāw wə·ḵōl yō·ḏə·‘ê šə·mōw ’im·rū ’ê·ḵāh niš·bar maṭ·ṭêh- ‘ōz maq·qêl tip̄·’ā·rāh
verses.literal: Mourn for him all you who surround him everyone who knows his name tell how the mighty scepter is shattered the glorious staff
verses.literalPt: Condoei-vos dele todos os que estais ao seu redor, e todos os que sabeis o seu nome; dizei: Como se quebrou a vara forte, o cajado formoso?

verses.original: רְדִ֤י מִכָּבוֹד֙ יֹשְׁבֶי בַצָּמָ֔א יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־ דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḏî mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ yō·šə·ḇɛ ḇaṣ·ṣā·mā yō·še·ḇeṯ baṯ- dî·ḇō·wn kî- šō·ḏêḏ mō·w·’āḇ ‘ā·lāh ḇāḵ ši·ḥêṯ miḇ·ṣā·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Come down from your glory sit on parched ground O daughter dwelling in Dibon for the destroyer of Moab has come against you he has destroyed your fortresses
verses.literalPt: Desce da tua glória, e assenta-te em terra seca, ó moradora, filha de Dibom; porque o destruidor de Moabe subiu contra ti, e desfez as tuas fortalezas.

verses.original: אֶל־ דֶּ֛רֶךְ עִמְדִ֥י וְצַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי־ נָ֣ס וְנִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה־ נִּֽהְיָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- de·reḵ ‘im·ḏî wə·ṣap·pî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ša·’ă·lî- nās wə·nim·lā·ṭāh ’im·rî mah- nih·yā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Stand by the road and watch O dweller of Aroer Ask the man fleeing or the woman escaping . . . What has happened
verses.literalPt: Põe-te no caminho, e espia, ó moradora de Aroer; pergunta ao que vai fugindo; e à que escapou dize: Que sucedeu?

verses.original: הֹבִ֥ישׁ מוֹאָ֛ב כִּֽי־ חַ֖תָּה הֵילִילִי וּזְעָקִי הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְאַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇîš mō·w·’āḇ kî- ḥat·tāh hē·lī·lī ū·zə·ʿå̄·qī hag·gî·ḏū ḇə·’ar·nō·wn kî šud·daḏ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Moab is put to shame for it has been shattered Wail and cry out Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed
verses.literalPt: Moabe está envergonhado, porque foi quebrantado; lamentai e gritai; anunciai em Arnom que Moabe está destruído.

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל־ חֹל֥וֹן וְאֶל־ יַ֖הְצָה וְעַל־ מוֹפָעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·pāṭ bā ’el- ’e·reṣ ham·mî·šōr ’el- ḥō·lō·wn wə·’el- yah·ṣāh wə·‘al- mō·p̄å̄·ʿaṯ
verses.literal: Judgment has come upon the high plain upon Holon . . . Jahzah and Mephaath
verses.literalPt: Também o julgamento veio sobre a terra da campina; sobre Holom, sobre Jaza, sobre Mefaate,

verses.original: וְעַל־ דִּיב֣וֹן וְעַל־ נְב֔וֹ וְעַל־ בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- dî·ḇō·wn wə·‘al- nə·ḇōw wə·‘al- bêṯ diḇ·lā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: upon Dibon . . . Nebo and Beth-diblathaim
verses.literalPt: Sobre Dibom, sobre Nebo, sobre Bete-Diblataim,

verses.original: וְעַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al qir·yā·ṯa·yim wə·‘al- bêṯ gā·mūl wə·‘al- bêṯ mə·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: upon Kiriathaim . . . Beth-gamul and Beth-meon
verses.literalPt: Sobre Quiriataim, sobre Bete-Gamul, sobre Bete-Meom,

verses.original: וְעַל־ קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְעַל־ בָּצְרָ֑ה וְעַ֗ל כָּל־ עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָרְחֹק֖וֹת וְהַקְּרֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- qə·rî·yō·wṯ wə·‘al- bāṣ·rāh wə·‘al kāl- ‘ā·rê ’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ hā·rə·ḥō·qō·wṯ wə·haq·qə·rō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: upon Kerioth . . . Bozrah . . . and all the towns of Moab those far and near
verses.literalPt: Sobre Queriote, e sobre Bozra; e até sobre todas as cidades da terra de Moabe, as de longe e as de perto.

verses.original: נִגְדְּעָה֙ קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב וּזְרֹע֖וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: niḡ·də·‘āh qe·ren mō·w·’āḇ ū·zə·rō·‘ōw niš·bā·rāh nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm is broken declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Já é cortado o poder de Moabe, e é quebrantado o seu braço, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕הוּ כִּ֥י עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּ֑יל וְסָפַ֤ק מוֹאָב֙ בְּקִיא֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֖ק גַּם־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: haš·kî·ru·hū kî ‘al- Yah·weh hiḡ·dîl wə·sā·p̄aq mō·w·’āḇ bə·qî·’ōw wə·hā·yāh liś·ḥōq gam- hū
verses.literal: Make him drunk because he has magnified himself against the LORD so Moab will wallow in his own vomit and he will also become a laughingstock
verses.literalPt: Embriagai-o, porque contra o SENHOR se engrandeceu; e Moabe se revolverá no seu vômito, e ele também se tornará objeto de escárnio.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ ל֣וֹא הַשְּׂחֹ֗ק הָיָ֤ה לְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־ בְּגַנָּבִ֖ים נִמְצָאָה כִּֽי־ מִדֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֥יךָ בּ֖וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im lō·w haś·śə·ḥōq hā·yāh lə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’im- bə·ḡan·nā·ḇîm nim·ṣå̄·ʾå̄h kî- mid·dê ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā bōw tiṯ·nō·w·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: Was not Israel your object of ridicule Was he ever found among thieves For whenever you speak of him you shake your head
verses.literalPt: Pois não foi também Israel objeto de escárnio? Porventura foi achado entre ladrões, para que sempre que fales dele, saltes de alegria?

verses.original: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְשִׁכְנ֣וּ בַּסֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽהְי֣וּ כְיוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּעֶבְרֵ֥י פִי־ פָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iz·ḇū ‘ā·rîm wə·šiḵ·nū bas·se·la‘ yō·šə·ḇê mō·w·’āḇ wih·yū ḵə·yō·w·nāh tə·qan·nên bə·‘eḇ·rê p̄î- p̄ā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks O dwellers of Moab Be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a cave
verses.literalPt: Deixai as cidades, e habitai no rochedo, ó moradores de Moabe; e sede como a pomba que se aninha nos lados da boca da caverna.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־ מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גָּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·nū ḡə·’ō·wn- mō·w·’āḇ gê·’eh mə·’ōḏ gā·ḇə·hōw ū·ḡə·’ō·w·nōw wə·ḡa·’ă·wā·ṯōw wə·rum lib·bōw
verses.literal: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity his exceeding pride and conceit his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart
verses.literalPt: Ouvimos da soberba de Moabe, que é soberbíssimo, como também da sua arrogância, e da sua vaidade, e da sua altivez e do seu orgulhoso coração.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖וֹ וְלֹא־ כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־ כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw wə·lō- ḵên bad·dāw lō- ḵên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: I know his insolence declares the LORD but it is futile . . . His boasting is as empty as his deeds
verses.literalPt: Eu conheço, diz o SENHOR, a sua indignação, mas isso nada é; as suas mentiras nada farão.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ עַל־ מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ‘al- mō·w·’āḇ ’ă·yê·lîl ū·lə·mō·w·’āḇ kul·lōh ’ez·‘āq ’el- ’an·šê qîr- ḥe·reś yeh·geh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will wail for Moab I will cry out for all of Moab I will moan for the men of Kir-heres
verses.literalPt: Por isso gemerei por Moabe, sim, gritarei por todo o Moabe; pelos homens de Quir-Heres lamentarei;

verses.original: מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־ לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֙יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־ קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־ בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·ḵî ya‘·zêr ’eḇ·keh- lāḵ hag·ge·p̄en śiḇ·māh nə·ṭî·šō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘ā·ḇə·rū yām ‘aḏ yām ya‘·zêr nā·ḡā·‘ū ‘al- qê·ṣêḵ wə·‘al- bə·ṣî·rêḵ šō·ḏêḏ nā·p̄āl
verses.literal: I will weep for you O vine of Sibmah more than I weep for Jazer Your tendrils have extended to the sea they reach even to Jazer The destroyer has descended on your summer fruit . . . and grape harvest
verses.literalPt: Com o choro de Jazer chorar-te-ei, ó vide de Sibma; os teus ramos passaram o mar, chegaram até ao mar de Jazer; porém o destruidor caiu sobre os teus frutos do verão, e sobre a tua vindima.

verses.original: וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְיַ֙יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·’es·p̄āh śim·ḥāh wā·ḡîl mik·kar·mel ū·mê·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ wə·ya·yin mî·qā·ḇîm hiš·bat·tî lō- yiḏ·rōḵ hê·ḏāḏ hê·ḏāḏ lō hê·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses no one treads them with shouts of joy their shouts are not for joy
verses.literalPt: Tirou-se, pois, o folguedo e a alegria do campo fértil e da terra de Moabe; porque fiz cessar o vinho nos lagares; já não pisarão uvas com júbilo; o júbilo não será júbilo.

verses.original: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־ אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד־ יַ֙הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם מִצֹּ֙עַר֙ עַד־ חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־ מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·za·‘ă·qaṯ ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- ’el·‘ā·lêh ‘aḏ- ya·haṣ nā·ṯə·nū qō·w·lām miṣ·ṣō·‘ar ‘aḏ- ḥō·rō·na·yim ‘eḡ·laṯ šə·li·šî·yāh kî gam- mê nim·rîm lim·šam·mō·wṯ yih·yū
verses.literal: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh they raise their voices to Jahaz from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah . . . for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up
verses.literalPt: Por causa do grito de Hesbom até Eleale e até Jaaz, se ouviu a sua voz desde Zoar até Horonaim, como bezerra de três anos; porque até as águas do Ninrim se tornarão em assolação.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî lə·mō·w·’āḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh ma·‘ă·leh ḇā·māh ū·maq·ṭîr lê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: In Moab declares the LORD I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods
verses.literalPt: E farei cessar em Moabe, diz o SENHOR, quem sacrifique nos altos, e queime incenso aos seus deuses.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י לְמוֹאָב֙ כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְלִבִּי֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lib·bî lə·mō·w·’āḇ ka·ḥă·li·lîm ye·hĕ·meh wə·lib·bî ’el- ’an·šê qîr- ḥe·reś ka·ḥă·lî·lîm ye·hĕ·meh ‘al- kên yiṯ·raṯ ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇā·ḏū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . My heart laments like a flute for Moab it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres because . . . the wealth they acquired has perished
verses.literalPt: Por isso ressoará como flauta o meu coração por Moabe, também ressoará como flauta o meu coração pelos homens de Quir-Heres; porquanto a abundância que ajuntou se perdeu.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְכָל־ זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל־ יָדַ֙יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־ מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl rōš qā·rə·ḥāh wə·ḵāl zā·qān gə·ru·‘āh ‘al kāl- yā·ḏa·yim gə·ḏu·ḏōṯ wə·‘al- mā·ṯə·na·yim śāq
verses.literal: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped on every hand is a gash and around every waist is sackcloth
verses.literalPt: Porque toda a cabeça será tosquiada, e toda a barba será diminuída; sobre todas as mãos haverá sarjaduras, e sobre os lombos, sacos.

verses.original: עַ֣ל כָּל־ גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־ שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב כִּכְלִ֛י אֵֽין־ חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al kāl- gag·gō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇir·ḥō·ḇō·ṯe·hā kul·lōh mis·pêḏ kî- šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ kiḵ·lî ’ên- ḥê·p̄eṣ bōw nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares everyone is mourning for I have shattered Moab like an unwanted jar declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Sobre todos os telhados de Moabe e nas suas ruas haverá um pranto geral; porque quebrei a Moabe, como a um vaso que não agrada, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֙תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה־ עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְהָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכָל־ סְבִיבָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ ḥat·tāh hê·lî·lū ’êḵ hip̄·nāh- ‘ō·rep̄ mō·w·’āḇ bō·wōš wə·hā·yāh mō·w·’āḇ liś·ḥōq wə·lim·ḥit·tāh lə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇāw
verses.literal: How shattered it is How they wail How Moab has turned his back in shame Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him
verses.literalPt: Como está quebrantado! Como gritam! Como virou Moabe a cerviz envergonhado! Assim será Moabe objeto de escárnio e de desmaio, para todos que estão em redor dele.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nêh ḵan·ne·šer yiḏ·’eh ū·p̄ā·raś kə·nā·p̄āw ’el- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Behold an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que voará como a águia, e estenderá as suas asas sobre Moabe.

verses.original: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nil·kə·ḏāh haq·qə·rî·yō·wṯ wə·ham·mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ niṯ·pā·śāh wə·hā·yāh lêḇ gib·bō·w·rê mō·w·’āḇ bay·yō·wm ha·hū kə·lêḇ ’iš·šāh mə·ṣê·rāh
verses.literal: Kirioth has been taken and the strongholds seized In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor
verses.literalPt: São tomadas as cidades, e ocupadas as fortalezas; e naquele dia será o coração dos valentes de Moabe como o coração da mulher que está com dores de parto.

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niš·maḏ mō·w·’āḇ mê·‘ām kî ‘al- Yah·weh hiḡ·dîl
verses.literal: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD
verses.literalPt: E Moabe será destruído, para que não seja povo; porque se engrandeceu contra o SENHOR.

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ wā·p̄a·ḥaṯ wā·p̄āḥ ‘ā·le·ḵā yō·wō·šêḇ mō·w·’āḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Terror and pit and snare await you O dweller of Moab declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Temor, e cova, e laço, vêm sobre ti, ó morador de Moabe, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הַנִּיס מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־ מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nīs mip·pə·nê hap·pa·ḥaḏ yip·pōl ’el- hap·pa·ḥaṯ wə·hā·‘ō·leh min- hap·pa·ḥaṯ yil·lā·ḵêḏ bap·pāḥ kî- ’ā·ḇî ’ê·le·hā ’el- mō·w·’āḇ šə·naṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Whoever flees . . . the panic will fall into the pit and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare For I will bring upon . . . Moab the year of their punishment declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: O que fugir do temor cairá na cova, e o que subir da cova ficará preso no laço; porque trarei sobre ele, sobre Moabe, o ano do seu castigo, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: בְּצֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּֽי־ אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶֽהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣêl ḥeš·bō·wn ‘ā·mə·ḏū mik·kō·aḥ nā·sîm kî- ’êš yā·ṣā mê·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·le·hā·ḇāh mib·bên sî·ḥō·wn wat·tō·ḵal pə·’aṯ mō·w·’āḇ wə·qā·ḏə·qōḏ bə·nê šā·’ō·wn
verses.literal: Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow because fire has gone forth from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult
verses.literalPt: Os que fugiam sem força pararam à sombra de Hesbom; pois saiu fogo de Hesbom, e a labareda do meio de Siom, e devorou o canto de Moabe e o alto da cabeça dos turbulentos.

verses.original: אוֹי־ לְךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖ד עַם־ כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ לֻקְּח֤וּ בָנֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּשֶּׁ֔בִי וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w- lə·ḵā mō·w·’āḇ ’ā·ḇaḏ ‘am- kə·mō·wōš kî- luq·qə·ḥū ḇā·ne·ḵā baš·še·ḇî ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā baš·šiḇ·yāh
verses.literal: Woe to you O Moab The people of Chemosh have perished for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity
verses.literalPt: Ai de ti, Moabe! Pereceu o povo de Quemós; porque teus filhos ficaram cativos, e tuas filhas em cativeiro.

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת־ מוֹאָ֛ב בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־ הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî šə·ḇūṯ- mō·w·’āḇ bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘aḏ- hên·nāh miš·paṭ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity declares the LORD Here ends the judgment on Moab
verses.literalPt: Mas nos últimos dias farei voltar os cativos de Moabe, diz o SENHOR. Até aqui o juízo de Moabe.
